subject: Chemistry
stem:
The major product of the following chemical reaction is :
\[(CH_3)_2CH-CH=CH_2 + HBr \xrightarrow{(C_6H_5CO)_2O_2} \; ?\]
solution:
\[(CH_3)_2CH-CH=CH_2 + HBr \xrightarrow{(C_6H_5CO)_2O_2} (CH_3)_2CH-CH_2-CH_2Br\]
Mechanism : Peroxide effect proceeds via free radical chain mechanism.
(i) \(C_6H_5-CO-O-O-CO-C_6H_5 \xrightarrow{Homolysis} 2C_6H_5-CO-\overset{..}{\underset{..}{O}} \rightarrow 2\dot{C_6H_5} + CO_2\)
(ii) \(\dot{C_6H_5} + H-Br \xrightarrow{Homolysis} C_6H_6 + \dot{Br}\)
(iii) \((CH_3)_2CH-CH=CH_2 + \dot{Br} \rightarrow (CH_3)_2CH-\dot{C}H-CH_2-Br\) (More stable secondary free radical)
(iv) \((CH_3)_2CH-\dot{C}H-CH_2-Br + H-Br \xrightarrow{Homolysis} (CH_3)_2CH-CH_2-CH_2-Br\) (Major product)

stem: A particular station of All India Radio, New Delhi broadcasts on a frequency of 1,368 kHz (kilohertz). The wavelength of the electromagnetic radiation emitted by the transmitter is : [speed of light \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8 \; ms^{-1}\)]
solution:
Energy of electromagnetic radiation (E) \(= \dfrac{hc}{\lambda} = h\gamma\)
So, \(\dfrac{c}{\lambda} = \gamma \Rightarrow \lambda = \dfrac{c}{\gamma}\)
\[\lambda = \dfrac{3\times 10^8}{1368 \times 10^3} = 219.3 \; m\]

stem:
Statement I : Acid strength increases in the order given as HF << HCl << HBr << HI.
Statement II : As the size of the elements F, Cl, Br, I increases down the group, the bond strength of HF, HCl, HBr and HI decreases and so the acid strength increases.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below.
options: Both statement I and Statement II are true
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Statement I is correct but statement II is false
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is true
solution:
In the modern periodic table, moving down the group as the size of halogen atom increases, the H \(-\) X bond length also increases as a result the bond enthalpy decreases. Hence, The acidic strength also increases.
So, the correct order of acidic strength is HI > HBr > HCl > HF

subject: Chemistry
stem: Which one among the following is the correct option for right relationship between \(C_P\) and \(C_V\) for one mole of ideal gas?
solution:
At constant volume, \(q_V = C_V\Delta T = \Delta U\)
At constant pressure, \(q_P = C_P\Delta T = \Delta H\)
For a mole of an ideal gas,
\(\Delta H = \Delta U + \Delta(PV) = \Delta U + \Delta(RT) = \Delta U + R\Delta T\)
On putting the values of \(\Delta H\) and \(\Delta U\), we have
\(C_P\Delta T = C_V\Delta T + R\Delta T\)
\(C_P = C_V + R\)
\(C_P - C_V = R\)

stem: The following solutions were prepared by dissolving 10 g of glucose \((C_6H_{12}O_6)\) in 250 ml of water \((P_1)\), 10 g of urea \((CH_4N_2O)\) in 250 ml of water \((P_2)\) and 10 g of sucrose \((C_{12}H_{22}O_{11})\) in 250 ml of water \((P_3)\). The right option for the decreasing order of osmotic pressure of these solutions is :
solution:
\(\bullet\) Osmotic pressure \((\pi) = iCRT\) where C is molar concentration of the solution
\(\bullet\) With increase in molar concentration of solution osmotic pressure increases.
\(\bullet\) Since, weight of all solutes and its solution volume are equal, so higher will be the molar mass of solute, smaller will be molar concentration and smaller will be the osmotic pressure.
\(\bullet\) Order of molar mass of solute decreases as Sucrose > Glucose > Urea
\(\bullet\) So, correct order of osmotic pressure of solution is \(P_3 < P_1 < P_2\)

stem: The major product formed in dehydrohalogenation reaction of 2-Bromo pentane is Pent-2-ene. This product formation is based on?
solution:
Major product formed in dehydrohalogenation reaction of 2-bromopentane is pent-2-ene because according to Saytzeff's rule, in dehydrohalogenation reactions, the preferred product is that alkene which has greater number of alkyl group(s) attached to the doubly bonded carbon atoms.
\[CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH(Br)-CH_3 \xrightarrow{OH^-} CH_3-CH_2-CH=CH-CH_3 \text{ (Pent-2-ene, 81\%)} + CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH=CH_2 \text{ (Pent-1-ene, 19\%)}\]

stem: The molar conductance of NaCl, HCl and \(CH_3COONa\) at infinite dilution are 126.45, 426.16 and 91.0 \(S \; cm^2 \; mol^{-1}\) respectively. The molar conductance of \(CH_3COOH\) at infinite dilution is. Choose the right option for your answer.
solution:
According to Kohlrausch law of independent migration of ions.
\(\Lambda^o_m(CH_3COOH) = \Lambda^o_m(CH_3COONa) + \Lambda^o_m(HCl) - \Lambda^o_m(NaCl)\)
\(= 91.0 \; S \; cm^2 \; mol^{-1} + 426.16 \; S \; cm^2 \; mol^{-1} - 126.45 \; S \; cm^2 \; mol^{-1}\)
\(= 390.71 \; S \; cm^2 \; mol^{-1}\)

solution:
Element C : Mass percentage 78%, No. of mole \(= \dfrac{78}{12} = 6.5\), Mole ratio \(= \dfrac{6.5}{6.5} = 1\)
Element H : Mass percentage 22%, No. of mole \(= \dfrac{22}{1} = 22\), Mole ratio \(= \dfrac{22}{6.5} = 3.38 \approx 3\)

stem: Choose the correct option for graphical representation of Boyle's law, which shows a graph of pressure vs. volume of a gas at different temperatures :
options: P vs V: three rectangular hyperbola (decreasing) curves; labelled 200 K, 400 K, 600 K from top to bottom
P vs V: single horizontal straight line labelled (200 K, 400 K, 600 K)
P vs V: three straight lines through origin with increasing slope; labelled 200 K, 400 K, 600 K
P vs V: three rectangular hyperbola (decreasing) curves; labelled 600 K, 400 K, 200 K from top to bottom
solution:
According to Boyle's law \(P \propto \dfrac{1}{V} \Rightarrow P = \dfrac{k}{V} \Rightarrow PV = k\) where k is proportionality constant and equal to nRT.
\(\therefore\) Graph between P vs. V should be rectangular hyperbola and product of PV increases with increase in temperature.

stem: For a reaction \(A \rightarrow B\), enthalpy of reaction is \(-4.2 \; kJ \; mol^{-1}\) and enthalpy of activation is \(9.6 \; kJ \; mol^{-1}\). The correct potential energy profile for the reaction is shown in option.
options: PE vs Reaction Progress: A and B at nearly the same low level with a tall symmetric barrier
PE vs Reaction Progress: A on the left at moderate height, small barrier, B on the right at a lower level (exothermic)
PE vs Reaction Progress: A and B at the same level with a symmetric barrier (thermoneutral)
PE vs Reaction Progress: A on the left at a low level, barrier, B on the right at a higher level (endothermic)
solution:
\(\bullet\) \(\Delta H_{rxn} = (E_a)_f - (E_a)_b\)
\(-4.2 = (E_a)_f - (E_a)_b\)
\(-4.2 = 9.6 - (E_a)_b\)
\((E_a)_b = 9.6 + 4.2 = 13.8 \; kJ \; mol^{-1}\)
\(\bullet\) Since reaction is exothermic, so possible graph is (2) only.
\(\bullet\) Also \((E_a)_f < (E_a)_b\), so answer is option (2).

stem: The slope of Arrhenius plot \(\left(\ln k \; v/s \; \dfrac{1}{T}\right)\) of first order reaction is \(-5 \times 10^3 K\). The value of \(E_a\) of the reaction is. Choose the correct option for your answer. [Given \(R = 8.314 \; JK^{-1}mol^{-1}\)]
solution:
Arrhenius equation \(k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}\)
\(\ln k = \ln A + \ln e^{-E_a/RT}\)
\(\ln k = \ln A - \dfrac{E_a}{R}\left(\dfrac{1}{T}\right) \longrightarrow (1)\)
Slope of \(\ln k\) vs \(\dfrac{1}{T}\) curve, \(m = -\dfrac{E_a}{R}\)
\(-5\times 10^3 = -\dfrac{E_a}{R}\)
\(E_a = 5 \times 10^3 \times 8.314 \; J/mol = 41.57 \times 10^3 \; J/mol \approx 41.5 \; kJ/mol\)

stem:
The molar conductivity of 0.007 M acetic acid is 20 \(S \; cm^2 \; mol^{-1}\). What is the dissociation constant of acetic acid? Choose the correct option.
\[\Lambda^o_{H^+} = 350 \; S \; cm^2 \; mol^{-1}, \quad \Lambda^o_{CH_3COO^-} = 50 \; S \; cm^2 \; mol^{-1}\]
solution:
\(\Lambda_m = 20 \; S \; cm^2 \; mol^{-1}\)
\(\Lambda^o_{m \; CH_3COOH} = \Lambda^o_{CH_3COO^-} + \Lambda^o_{m \; H^+} = 50 + 350 = 400 \; S \; cm^2 \; mol^{-1}\)
\(\alpha = \dfrac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda^o_m} = \dfrac{20}{400} = \dfrac{1}{20}\)
\(K_a = \dfrac{C\alpha^2}{1-\alpha} \approx C\alpha^2 = 7\times 10^{-3}\times\left(\dfrac{1}{20}\right)^2 = 7\times 10^{-3}\times\dfrac{1}{4}\times 10^{-2} = 1.75\times 10^{-5} \; mol \; L^{-1}\)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below.
solution:
\(\bullet\) Tropospheric pollution: In the presence of pollutant, \(SO_2\) converts into \(SO_3\). \(2SO_2 + O_2 \rightarrow 2SO_3\)
\(\bullet\) In spring season, sunlight breaks HOCl and \(Cl_2\) to give chlorine radicals. \(HOCl \xrightarrow{h\nu} \dot{O}H(g) + \dot{C}l(g)\). These chlorine radicals deplete ozone layer
\(\bullet\) High level of sulphur causes acid rain which reacts with marble and causes discolouring and disfiguring. \(CaCO_3 + H_2SO_4 \rightarrow CaSO_4 + H_2O + CO_2\)
\(\bullet\) A chain reaction occurs from interaction of NO with sunlight in which NO is converted to \(NO_2\) which absorb energy from sunlight and breaks into NO and O, which causes photochemical smog. \(NO_2(g) \xrightarrow{h\nu} NO(g) + O(g)\)
